DNF.why: makes the thin-film deposition precursors (DPT/QPT patterning, DRAM capacitor high-k, low-temperature SiO/SiN) that Samsung and SK Hynix use in DRAM / HBM and V-NAND production; 93.09% of revenue is semiconductor materials
DNF.evidence: DART half-year report 08-14-2026: 'the company's main customers are Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in Korea and TSMC, PSMC and Winbond overseas'; products are DPT/QPT patterning sacrificial-layer materials, high-k capacitor dielectric precursors and low-temperature SiO/SiN precursors

players.product: DPT/QPT patterning sacrificial-layer precursors (DIPAS), DRAM capacitor high-k precursors (Cp-Zr), low-temperature SiO/SiN precursors (HCDS), ACL hardmask and diffusion-barrier materials (TDMAT, 4MS)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, separate statements): H1 revenue KRW 42,574,031,960 vs KRW 35,664,582,042 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 1,414,881,532 vs an operating loss of KRW 1,714,945,557. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 21,694,844,465 (Q2 2025: KRW 18,384,119,545), operating profit KRW 704,554,808 (Q2 2025: loss of KRW 1,180,833,725), net profit KRW 657,131,029. Segments: semiconductor materials KRW 39,631M (93.09% of revenue), other chemical materials (research products) KRW 2,943M (6.91%). Exports KRW 4,555,312,409 and domestic sales KRW 38,018,719,551; by region China KRW 3,808,547 thousand, Taiwan KRW 628,426 thousand, US KRW 109,709 thousand.

Capacity and utilisation, H1 2026: maximum output 193,630 kg against production of 106,036 kg, a utilisation of 54.76% -- Daejeon campus 1 (headquarters; DPT and main products) 76,020 kg capacity, 41,595 kg produced, 54.72%; Daejeon campus 2 (other products) 18,810 kg, 7,306 kg, 38.84%; Ulsan campus (ACL) 98,880 kg, 57,135 kg, 57.83%. H1 property, plant and equipment additions were about KRW 5,128M, mostly to improve research and manufacturing facilities; investment commitments for construction in progress totalled KRW 1,361M at the half-year end. The company says future facility investment will be run flexibly after reviewing market and industry trends.
quarterly_data.figure: Utilisation 54.76% (106,036 kg of 193,630 kg); PP&E additions KRW 5,128M; capex commitments KRW 1,361M

quarterly_data.signal: Customers: the company's main customers are Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in Korea and TSMC, PSMC and Winbond overseas; most revenue comes from Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and overseas chipmakers. A single unnamed customer ('major customer 1', over 10% of revenue) accounted for KRW 39,161,234 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (H1 2025: KRW 32,106,805 thousand). There is no fixed order backlog: the company ships against customers' daily purchase orders. Ownership: Soulbrain holds 35.03% and consolidated DNF as a subsidiary from April 1; Samsung Electronics holds 7.00%.
quarterly_data.figure: Major customer 1 KRW 39,161,234 thousand of KRW 42,574,032 thousand H1 revenue; Soulbrain 35.03%, Samsung Electronics 7.00%

quarterly_data.signal: Products and technology: DPT materials (supplied since 2012) are sacrificial-layer patterning materials for sub-40nm patterns and still hold a high market share; high-k precursors, supplied in volume since H2 2013, are DRAM capacitor dielectric materials, and the company develops and supplies precursors for 20-30nm processes while researching next-generation high-k materials; low-temperature SiO/SiN precursors are used in DRAM and NAND flash. R&D targets next-generation ALD/CVD metal precursors, ALD/CVD Si precursors and high-mobility thin-film-transistor materials; H1 R&D spend KRW 3,188,774,156 (7.5% of revenue). The company holds 182 registered patents (64 in Korea, 118 abroad) and estimates its share of the Korean deposition-materials market at about 8%.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 R&D KRW 3,188,774,156 (7.5% of revenue); ~8% domestic deposition-materials share; 182 patents

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (half-year report): Korean memory makers continue leading-edge process transitions and HBM capacity investment, which the company says is expanding demand for ALD / CVD precursors and high-purity materials; with AI and data-center demand lifting high-performance memory, the company expects sales of its main products to grow as well. In V-NAND, usage of its low-temperature SiO/SiN precursors rises with layer count and the company expects continued sales growth.
